name: co.avagama/openings
title: Openings
description: Search jobs on verified employer job boards. Every link is the employer's own posting.

tools.name: prepare_job_search
tools.description: Download and refresh the local job index so searches have data to read. The first call fetches the shared index of every verified source (thousands of employers); later calls crawl only missing or stale sources, at most 25 per call, returning a continuation token until nextAction reports ready. Call it when a search says setup is needed, not before every search, and not at all on the hosted server, where the index is already prepared and this returns ready at once. Uses the network and writes job data under the local Openings data directory; it never reads, writes or transmits a resume.

countries.description: Two-letter codes whose sources should be prepared, such as IN or US

continuation.description: Opaque token from the previous call's result. Pass it back to prepare the next batch of at most 25 sources; omit it to start

tools.name: get_job_coverage
tools.description: Report how many live roles the index holds for each country and how recently they were posted. Use it to set expectations before asking a candidate for anything, or to judge whether preparation is worth running; use search_jobs instead to see the roles themselves. Reads the index already on hand and never crawls.

countries.description: Two-letter codes to report coverage for, such as IN or US

tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search jobs immediately from role, country, location and optional stated experience. No resume required. Newest first; automatically widens 7, 14, 30 days then all dates until 5 matches. For another page reuse the same filters and returned window.daysUsed as maxAgeDays, with pagination.nextOffset. Resume-based ranking is optional via recommend_jobs.

query.description: Words to match in job title or company

country.description: Two-letter country code for job eligibility, such as IN or DE

remote.description: True for remote-only; false for non-remote-only

maxAgeDays.description: Omit to widen 7/14/30/all until 5 matches. Explicit positive values exclude undated roles; 0 includes all dates.

limit.description: How many jobs to return in this page

offset.description: Where the page starts. Use pagination.nextOffset from the previous result rather than counting by hand

experienceYears.description: Years of experience to compare with the posting's stated min/max range; not a qualification or fit verdict.

includeUnknownExperience.description: With experienceYears, also keep roles without a stated range, clearly unknown rather than matched.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Get the full description and application URL for a job returned by recommend_jobs or search_jobs.

id.description: Stable job id returned by search_jobs or recommend_jobs (jobId is accepted too)
